comparison.objective: Inflate a tyre to 1.5 bar using a gauge-less pump while keeping its head on the valve; no spec versions are available.
comparison.physical_skill: One hand stabilizes a push-on head while the other performs and counts repeated pump strokes.
comparison.success_condition: Reach 1.5 bar with the head maintained on the valve throughout; pressure tolerance and stroke calibration are absent.
comparison.reason: It shares bimanual tool stabilization plus striking-like arm motion, but tests repeated pumping and action counting—not impulse-regulated notch fracture, insert preservation, and fragment containment.
